description_en: Queries all recording index files in the specified period of time
description_zh: 调用ListLiveRecordFiles查询某个时间段内的所有录制索引文件
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-record-files --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:01Z --job-ids 9E83D5D0-8D72-5E7D-B61A-0000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by asc --record-format m3u8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveRecordFiles

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The maximum time range to query is four days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。与StartTime间隔时间不能超过4天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 5 to 30. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值范围：5~30，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the index files by creation time. Valid values:

asc: The query results are displayed in ascending order. This is the default value.

desc: The query results are displayed in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序。取值：

asc（默认值）：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The format of the recording file. Valid values:

M3U8, FLV, and MP4
parameters.help_zh:
录制文件格式。取值：

m3u8， flv， mp4
parameters.name: record_format
